displayDescription: Night-ink motion poster: a vermilion idea disc expands, links draw out, eight nodes connect, and the headline completes.
audioDescription: Silent preview. No audio track, music or voice.
limitations: STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes and no reviewed recipes were supplied, so the refresh demonstrates the source-frame palette and construction lessons rather than a named recipe.
Vector-only approximation of print: the grain is a fixed-seed SVG feTurbulence overlay and the halftone is a regular dot pattern. Neither is a scanned paper or ink texture.
The halo is a flat radial gradient standing in for light. It is not physically lit.
The footer copy was changed from 'LOOP 00:00 — 00:06 · ENDPOINTS MATCH' to 'PREVIEW 00:00 — 00:03 · SILENT' because this 3 s preview builds from a seed to the full poster and does not loop.

The motion libraries suggested in the pool (Motion, mo.js, Anime.js) were not used. GSAP owns every animated property, which keeps a single seekable timeline. Blender was not used, per the user's instruction.
Typography uses local system Helvetica Neue with Helvetica/Arial fallbacks, so glyph widths can differ slightly between hosts.
